info.title: Maison XOS — Experience OS capability API
info.description:
The hotel operator's system of record for on-stay experiences (spa, activities, excursions, rentals, transfers): catalog → sellable gate → publish → availability → bookings → guests → inbox.

**Shape.** Every capability is `POST /api/v1/<name>` with a JSON body and a JSON response; names are verbs, never CRUD. Each operation is designed to be handed to the Maison ADK as a tool: `operationId` is the tool name, the request schema is the tool input, the 200 body is the tool output.

**Auth.** `Authorization: Bearer <credential>` on every capability: a portal-issued JWT (user tokens from the portal, machine tokens from the portal's OAuth token endpoint) or a portal API key (`mk_…`). Only `GET /health` and `GET /openapi.json` are open.

**Tenancy.** The tenant is always the **client**. The client comes from the credential's `client` claim — never from the request. The optional `propertyId` body field selects a property within that client (default: the client's first property); a property outside the client is a 404. Machine credentials are scoped to exactly one client. A user token with `client: null` (all clients) resolves only when this deployment serves a single client; otherwise the user must pick a client in the portal.

**Money and dates.** Amounts are numbers in major units of the accompanying `currency`; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; times are `HH:MM`; timestamps are ISO-8601.

**Errors.** Non-2xx responses are `{ error, details? }`.

post.summary: Reserve a slot for a guest (confirmed, or held for 15 minutes with hold=true)
post.description: Checks lead time (in the property's timezone), party limits and remaining capacity, prices the booking exactly like `quote-experience` (a missing variantId resolves to the default variant), resolves or creates the guest, and reserves capacity on the slot — for per_unit experiences that is the day pool, whatever time is requested. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so retries never double-book.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-chosen key, scoped to the calling credential. Repeating a request with the same key and the same payload returns the original booking instead of creating a second one — always send it from a retrying channel. The same key with a different payload is refused (422).

propertyId.description: Optional. Selects a property within the caller's client; defaults to the client's first property. An id outside the client is a 404.

400.description: Invalid input (zod issues in `details`) or no client could be resolved for the credential

404.description: Experience or variant not found in this client/property

409.description: Slot sold out, closed, blocked, or inside the lead time

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different payload

hold.description: true = leave the booking in `held` (expires in 15 min) instead of confirming

lastMessagePreview.description: First 140 characters of the latest message

externalRef.description: The channel's own conversation id — idempotent thread key

experienceId.description: Must belong to the tenant (404 otherwise)

bookingId.description: Must belong to the tenant (404 otherwise)

status.description: Flag for the operator. Default by role: guest → needs_attention, agent → ai_handled, operator → waiting, system → unchanged
